heroHeadline: Pakistan Rejects India's 'Baseless' UN Map Claims on Kashmir; Operation Ashdar Kills Pakistani LeT Commander
heroSubtitle: September 7, 2026: A UN General Assembly resolution correcting map-projection distortions ('Correct the Map,' adopted September 4 with 164 votes) reignited the India-Pakistan cartographic dispute over Jammu & Kashmir. India's MEA said September 6 its support for the resolution did not endorse any particular boundary depiction and that J&K and Ladakh 'must be depicted in accordance with India's official map'; Pakistan's Foreign Office rejected this September 7 as 'baseless assertions... contrary to internationally recognized facts,' reiterating that UN maps showing J&K as disputed 'remain the only cartographic representation of its current legal status.' Separately, a joint Army-Police-CRPF operation codenamed Operation Ashdar killed Pakistani Lashkar-e-Taiba operative Yasir in a roughly 12-hour encounter in Budgam's Ashdar Gali/Yousmarg area on September 4; his identity was confirmed a day later, and a search for at least one more suspected terrorist continued. On September 3, BSF apprehended Pakistani national Nazir Sadhir after he inadvertently crossed the International Border near Kanachak, Jammu, repatriating him via the Golpattan Border Out-Post by September 7. Earlier in the week, PM Modi told the SCO summit in Bishkek (September 1) there is 'no place for double standards' on terrorism in a veiled message to Pakistan; Pakistan's FO urged India September 2 to comply with the August 31 Hague ruling on the Indus Waters Treaty 'in letter and spirit'; and Pakistan marked its 61st Defence Day on September 6, with leadership invoking last year's four-day conflict with India. The LoC itself has seen no new firing or infiltration incidents since the August 27-29 drone cluster; the ceasefire holds at Day 485 with no confirmed cross-border fire exchange since May 10, 2025. Bilateral freeze remains otherwise comprehensive: no ambassadors, $0 formal trade, IWT in abeyance.
footerNote: Data sourced from Indian MEA/MOD, Pakistan ISPR/MFA, UN Security Council, SIPRI, Crisis Group, HRW, Stimson Center
